items.source: Add a parameter with an instance value.
items.translation: 添加一个具有实例值的参数。

items.source: Add a parameter with an instance factory.
items.translation: 添加一个带有实例工厂的参数。

items.source: instance - the instance that should be injected
factory - the factory used to create the instance that should be injected
items.translation: factory - 用于创建应被注入实例的工厂

items.source: Callback used to register available parameters.
items.translation: 用于注册可用参数的回调。
